newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-FREE STATE WIN TOSS AND BAT AGAINST INDIA.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-FREE STATE WIN TOSS AND BAT AGAINST INDIA.

text.p: Free State won the toss and chose to bat on the opening day of the three day match against India at Springbok Park on Saturday.
Free State: Gerhardus Liebenberg (captain), Deon Jordaan, Boeta Dippenaar, Hansie Cronje, Chris Craven, Kosie Venter, Nicky Boje, Bradley Player, Philip Radley, Herman Bakkes, Sarel Cillers.
India - Workeri Raman, Vikram Rathore, Rahul Dravid, Saurav Ganguly, V.V.S.Laxman, Pankaj Dharmani, Anil Kumble (captain), Saba Karim, David Johnson, Doda Ganesh, Venkatapathy Raju.
